title: AI‑Agentic Cloud Revolution: GPU‑Enabled Serverless, Dedicated AI VMs, and Integrated Data Services Redefine the Cloud Landscape (Nov 2026)
core_insight: AI‑agentic workloads are driving a simultaneous rollout of specialized high‑performance compute (GPU‑enabled serverless, dedicated AI VMs) and integrated cloud‑native services across major providers, marking a shift to model‑centric enterprise cloud architectures.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS added GPU support to Lambda and extended timeout, Google launched GKE‑based AlloyDB and Managed Airflow agents, while Azure introduced Cobalt 200 VMs and Catalyst for Agentic AI, collectively strengthening containerized, serverless, and agent‑centric workloads. AWS released GPT‑6.1 Terra on Bedrock and GA'd Continuum AI security; Google delivered AlloyDB Omni with on‑prem large models and Spark Managed Service 4.0; Azure rolled out Cobalt 200 hardware and Catalyst innovations; Cloudflare unveiled Clairic open‑source AI models, together boosting AI inference, data analytics, and edge AI capabilities. AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Bogotá, 30-minute Lambda timeout, and more AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more Data + AI Anywhere: AlloyDB Omni integration with local models DynaPORT modernization on Google Cloud with AlloyDB for PostgreSQL and GKE What’s new in Managed Service for Apache Spark 4.0 Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era Continuous improvement comes to Microsoft Foundry
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS opened a Local Zone in Bogotá to improve low‑latency compute in Latin America; Azure has no specific regional pricing announcements but its Cobalt 200 VM and Catalyst offerings improve cost‑performance; Google reported no new regional pricing this week. AWS made GPU instances available for Lambda; Azure introduced Cobalt 200 VMs built on custom silicon for AI workloads; Google announced no new chip or GPU supply; Volcengine added ByteHouse high‑performance real‑time analytics engine, expanding domestic compute options. dimension_texts.application: AI agents entered retail via Walmart‑Meta Muse, logistics via DynaPORT maritime transformation, enterprise workflows through Microsoft‑Oracle Agentic AI partnership, and real‑time analytics via Volcengine ByteHouse. Salesforce launched AI Lead Qualification and Agentforce Coworker; Google highlighted migrations to AlloyDB + GKE and AI‑powered analytics; Microsoft introduced IQ and Foundry for continuous AI agent evaluation; Azure Catalyst and Cobalt 200 empower model‑as‑service across industries.
